mapper.sql: FROM order_info o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN device_info d ON o.device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN gate_info g ON o.gate_id = g.gate_id

where.if: AND ( o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.customer_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.device_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.device_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.customer_id, c.user_name, c.mobile, o.device_id, d.device_sn, d.device_name, o.gate_id, g.gate_name, o.order_amount, o.pay_amount, o.coupon_amount, o.trx_time, o.pay_time, o.order_status, o.procedure_type, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.remarks
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT o.*, c.user_name, c.mobile, c.ali_open_id, c.wechat_open_id, d.device_sn, d.device_name, d.device_status, g.gate_name, g.gate_code, g.gate_status FROM order_info o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN device_info d ON o.device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN gate_info g ON o.gate_id = g.gate_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, event_time, event_type, event_tag, device_sn, event_level, content, process_status FROM device_event WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY event_time DESC
SELECT id, order_no, product_id, product_name, sku_code, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, create_time FROM order_item WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, refund_no, order_no, refund_amount, refund_reason, status, operator, create_time, update_time FROM order_refund_record WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, adjust_no, order_no, adjust_type, adjust_amount, adjust_reason, status, operator, create_time, update_time FROM order_adjust_record WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, exception_no, order_no, exception_type, description, process_status, process_result, operator, create_time, update_time FROM order_exception_record WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE order_status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE order_status IN ('UN_PAID', 'INIT', 'PRE_AUTH_CREATE_SUCCESS', 'PRE_AUTH_SUCCESS', 'IN_PAYMENT')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM order_info WHERE order_status = 'FULLY_PAY' AND DATE(COALESCE(pay_time, create_time)) = CURDATE()
mapper.update: UPDATE order_info SET order_status = #{status}, update_time = now(), pay_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'FULLY_PAY' AND pay_time IS NULL THEN now() ELSE pay_time END WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.select: SELECT order_no, pay_amount, order_status FROM order_info WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT order_no, order_status FROM order_info WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) FROM order_refund_record WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'SUCCESS'
mapper.update: UPDATE order_exception_record SET process_status = 'DONE', process_result = #{result}, operator = #{operator}, update_time = now() WHERE exception_no = #{exceptionNo}
UPDATE order_exception_record SET process_status = 'DONE', process_result = #{result}, operator = #{operator}, update_time = now() WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND process_status <> 'DONE'
